title: No signs, no lights. Who goes first? 🚗 #shorts
description:
Most drivers get this wrong. Who has to wait - you or the car?
Comment your answer 👇

#roadrules #driving #quiz #noggin #shorts

scenes.question: Who has to wait - you or the car?
scenes.why: No signs? The car coming from your right goes first.

different: No one has automatic priority. Both drivers must take care.
The first car to arrive goes first. Only if you arrive together does the car on the right go.
They drive on the left, so the car from the left goes first.
